crossRefs.note: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;
Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
The burden of Egypt. “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry…
I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord…
Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
It will happen, when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “Such as are for…
For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and…
This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will…
Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.
translations.bsb: He will come and strike down the land of Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
translations.kjv: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
translations.asv: And he shall come, and shall smite the land of Egypt; such as are for death shall be given to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.
